product_overview: Market Oracle Dashboard is a dark-first trading assistant for traders and investors who want fast, quantitative snapshots for buy/sell/hold decisions. It surfaces market context, portfolio status, analysis workflows, and trade journaling in a clean, highly legible interface.
core_goals: Review today’s prioritized market and portfolio actions at a glance
Inspect portfolio holdings, watchlist items, and risk exposure
Analyze a ticker with quote data, decision context, and guided commentary
Record and review trades in a structured journal
Track performance metrics and equity trends from journal history
Adjust system preferences and runtime configuration

features.name: Today Overview
features.description: Shows a daily queue of market and portfolio actions with status indicators and links to related workflows.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View today cards and status badges -> Select a card to continue to the related page -> Review the linked market or portfolio context
Navigate to / -> Refresh the today queue data -> View the updated action list and statuses

features.name: Portfolio Dashboard
features.description: Provides a portfolio summary, holdings table, and watchlist management tools.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View portfolio summary metrics -> Browse holdings table rows -> Add a ticker to the watchlist -> See the watchlist update
Navigate to /dashboard -> View portfolio summary metrics -> Remove a ticker from the watchlist -> See the watchlist update
Navigate to /dashboard -> Use a quick action to jump to analysis or journal -> Open the related workflow page

features.name: Command Center Analysis
features.description: Lets users look up a ticker, run deeper analysis, chat about the ticker, and log a trade from the analysis workspace.
user_flows: Navigate to /command-center -> Enter a ticker symbol -> Search quote data -> View the ticker quote panel
Navigate to /command-center -> Enter a ticker symbol -> Search quote data -> Run deep analysis for the selected ticker -> Review the analysis results
Navigate to /command-center -> Enter a ticker symbol -> Search quote data -> Switch to chat workspace mode -> Send a message about the ticker -> View the response in the chat thread
Navigate to /command-center -> Enter a ticker symbol -> Search quote data -> Open the trade ticket drawer -> Submit a journal entry -> See the trade recorded in the workflow

features.name: Trade Journal
features.description: Provides a filterable and sortable log of trades with expandable details and trade entry tools.
user_flows: Navigate to /journal -> Filter the journal by ticker, mode, status, or date -> Sort the table columns -> Inspect the narrowed trade list
Navigate to /journal -> Expand a trade row -> Review the trade detail information
Navigate to /journal -> Open the Log Trade drawer -> Enter trade details -> Submit the trade -> See the journal update
Navigate to /journal -> Select a ticker link in a row -> Open the ticker detail page
Navigate to /journal -> Select a command center link in a row -> Open the analysis workspace

features.name: Analytics
features.description: Displays performance statistics, metric cards, and an equity curve derived from journal data.
user_flows: Navigate to /analytics -> View analytics metric cards -> Inspect the equity curve chart
Navigate to /analytics -> Apply date and mode filters -> View the refreshed metrics and chart

features.name: System Config
features.description: Allows users to browse configuration sections, edit preferences, and save updates.
user_flows: Navigate to /config -> Browse config sidebar sections -> Open a settings section -> Edit preference fields -> Save configuration changes
Navigate to /config -> Change runtime or preference values -> Save configuration changes -> See the updated settings persist

features.name: Market Explorer
features.description: Lets users browse market themes, sectors, and display-only quote data for exploration.
user_flows: Navigate to /market -> Browse sector themes -> Inspect display-only quote data -> Compare market ideas across themes
Navigate to /market -> Review an item in the market explorer -> Open the related ticker detail view if available

features.name: Ticker Detail
features.description: Shows per-ticker quote information, decision packets, journal history, and analysis context for a specific symbol.
user_flows: Navigate to a ticker detail page from a linked workflow -> Review quote data and decision packet -> Inspect journal history and analysis context
Navigate to a ticker detail page from a linked workflow -> Review the ticker information -> Continue into related analysis or journal context

routes.description: Today overview queue with actionable cards and market context
Portfolio holdings summary, watchlist panel, and quick actions
Portfolio risk metrics, concentration, and scenario planning
Market explorer with sector themes and display-only quote data
Per-ticker detail with quote, decision packet, journal history, and analysis
Stock analysis workspace with quote panel, agent results, chat, and trade ticket

Performance analytics, equity curve, and journal-derived metrics
System configuration and user preferences editor

known_limitations.issue: Clerk sign-in flow is bypassed in dev:ui mode; login UI is not exercised during TestSprite runs
known_limitations.impact: Production Clerk auth must be tested separately with needLogin true

known_limitations.issue: Onboarding page may block main shell until preferences.onboarding_completed is true
known_limitations.impact: First-run users see onboarding instead of dashboard until preferences are saved

known_limitations.issue: Deep analysis and chat depend on backend AI keys and external market data availability
known_limitations.impact: Analyze/chat endpoints may fail or return errors when API keys or quote providers are unavailable
